title: 1968 AHSME Problem 25
statement: Ace runs with constant speed and Flash runs \(x\) times as fast, \(x\gt1.\) Flash gives Ace a head start of \(y\) yards, and, at a given signal, they start off in the same direction. Then the number of yards Flash must run to catch Ace is:

solutions.text:
If Ace runs at speed \(v,\) Flash runs at \(xv,\) so their closing speed is \((x-1)v.\) The catch-up time is \(\frac{y}{(x-1)v},\) during which Flash runs \(\frac{xv\cdot y}{(x-1)v}=\frac{xy}{x-1}.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is C.
hints: If Ace’s speed is \(v,\) the closing speed is \((x-1)v\)
Multiply the catch-up time by Flash’s speed \(xv\)
